result: Jack opened with a big fish, sketching it on the pad and laying the top of the body. Sofia swept the belly round toward the tail. When Omar got slow, Sofia took the tail herself, and Omar bridged the top line over to meet it. Hana added the top fin and skipped the eye, since it would be "one more joint that could break." The turning point came at the tail, where Sofia found a small kink and nudged it into line. Then the team went hands off and watched for bumps. When the start domino was pushed, all 139 of 139 fell. Judges guessed fish, shark, whale, dolphin, and bird, but the players all saw one thing: a fish.
